description: This file contains unit tests for the ViewHtml class within the SuiteCRM project. It tests the instantiation of the class and its display method, extending a PHPUnit test case class.

classes.name: ViewHtmlTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the ViewHtml component in SuiteCRM, extending the SuitePHPUnitFrameworkTestCase and testing instantiation and display functionality.

methods.name: testViewHtml
methods.description: Tests that the ViewHtml object can be instantiated and is an instance of ViewHtml and SugarView.

methods.name: testdisplay
methods.description: Invokes the display method on a ViewHtml instance, ensuring no exceptions are thrown.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by creating a mock current_user and loading default config.
